docs.title: Freeze and unfreeze your card
docs.summary: Temporarily freeze your card to prevent transactions, then unfreeze anytime.
docs.body: Freezing your card stops most new transactions immediately. Use this if you suspect your card details may be compromised or you’ve misplaced the card. When you’re ready, unfreeze the card in settings. Some pending transactions may still complete depending on the merchant.

docs.title: Why isn’t my card working?
docs.summary: Common reasons a card payment may fail and how to fix it quickly.
docs.body: If your card payment fails, start by checking your balance, payment limits, and whether the merchant supports your card type. Then verify your card isn’t frozen and that your billing address matches what the merchant expects. If the issue persists, try a smaller amount, retry after a few minutes, and confirm there are no security blocks on your account.

docs.title: Update your profile information
docs.summary: Change your name, contact details, and preferences from your account settings.
docs.body: Open Account settings to update your personal details. Some fields may require re-verification for security reasons. After saving changes, confirm they appear correctly across your profile and notifications.
